changelog: Stitch-Guided Minimal Dark Settings Panel Redesign: Redesigned the settings panel following Google Stitch guidelines to match Gravent's elite mobile IDE aesthetic with Level 1/2 dark surfaces (#15151A, #181820), hairline borders (#24242C, #262630), crisp typography hierarchy, and restrained indigo (#818CF8) and live status (#22C55E) accents, eliminating rainbow color chaos

Developer Daemon HUD Status Ribbon: Added a live runtime status strip at the top of the settings panel showing active agents count, MCP server health, Hub connectivity, and a global Expand/Collapse All pill control

Harmonized Category & Nav Card Styling: Unified all 6 expandable category groups and sub-screens (including Claude Code and Utilities) with squircle icon badges, hairline chevron rotation, and muted status tags
Ultra-Resilient Copilot Token Streaming: Enhanced streaming parser to extract content and text tokens from both chunk deltas and non-streaming responses, ensuring zero dropped messages
